After read_text_file returns the source material relevant to the current request context, continue with copy_document at the requested output location.
Arguments:
- path (string, required)
- tail (number, optional) - If provided, returns only the last N lines of the file
- head (number, optional) - If provided, returns only the first N lines of the file
